title: GrantThai named review record
description: Draft. One record covers exactly one gate (gate_id); a review of several gates is several records. Field list matches spec/common/review_gates.yaml review_record.required_fields. No cryptographic signing in v0.x. content_sha256 is the project content hash defined in spec/common/object-hash.md; it excludes every status, review record and lock, so writing this record, or promoting field statuses through it, does not make it stale.

scope.description: Which fields or chain nodes within the gate this record covers.

basis.description: Plain-language basis for the review outcome.

outcome.description: Rendered as AUTHOR_CHECKED when independence == self and outcome == VERIFIED (spec/common/status.yaml).
